legal.terms.acceptanceContent: By accessing and using this portal, directory, and community forum of Servicios Mallorca, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions of Use, as well as our Privacy Policy.
legal.terms.servicesContent: Servicios Mallorca is an independent informational directory and community platform providing verified business listings, schedules, locations, and reviews across Mallorca.
legal.terms.obligationsContent: Users commit to making lawful and respectful use of the platform, guaranteeing review accuracy and respecting third-party rights.
legal.terms.privacyContent: All personal data processing strictly adheres to the GDPR (EU 2016/679) and Spanish LOPD-GDD, ensuring user confidentiality and rights at all times.
legal.terms.intellectualContent: All editorial content, design, and code of Servicios Mallorca are exclusive property. Business trademarks, logos, and photos belong to their respective owners.
legal.terms.liabilityContent: Servicios Mallorca operates as an informative guide. We are not a contractual party and assume no direct liability for services performed by listed providers.
legal.terms.modificationsContent: We reserve the right to update these terms to reflect legal or technical requirements, always displaying the latest revision date.
legal.terms.contactContent: For legal inquiries, contact legal@serviciosmallorca.es. Any dispute shall be submitted to the Courts of Palma de Mallorca, Spain.
legal.privacy.dataUse: 2. Purpose and Legal Basis for Processing
legal.privacy.dataCollectionContent: We strictly collect data necessary for account management (email, name, avatar), business verification requests, bug reports, and essential technical navigation data.
legal.privacy.dataUseContent: Your data is processed for authentication, user dashboard administration, business ownership/deletion requests, and community review publications with your explicit consent.
legal.privacy.dataSharingContent: We do not sell personal data. We rely on high-security services such as Google Firebase (secure hosting) and Google AdSense for contextual advertising complying with privacy standards.
legal.privacy.userRightsContent: You may at any time exercise your rights to Access, Rectification, Erasure ('right to be forgotten'), Restriction, Portability, and Objection by emailing privacidad@serviciosmallorca.es or directly in your dashboard.
legal.privacy.securityContent: We implement TLS/HTTPS encryption on all communications, user-isolated database security rules, HTTP protection headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options), and strict access control.
legal.privacy.cookiesContent: We use technical cookies to store language and visual theme preferences, as well as Google AdSense advertising cookies managed in accordance with EU privacy regulations.
legal.privacy.businessActionDesc: If you are the owner or legal representative of a business in Mallorca, you can claim ownership to customize it or exercise your right to immediate listing removal.
